archive.title: Palace of the Fans
archive.caption: Palace of the Fans was a Major League baseball park located in Cincinnati, Ohio. It was the home of the Cincinnati Reds from 1902 through 1911.

archive.title: 1919 World Series
archive.caption: The 1919 World Series was the championship series in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the 1919 season.

archive.title: Riverfront Stadium
archive.caption: Riverfront Stadium, also known as Cinergy Field from 1996 to 2002, was a multi-purpose stadium in Cincinnati, Ohio.

archive.title: Big Red Machine
archive.caption: The Big Red Machine is a nickname for the Cincinnati Reds baseball team that dominated the National League from 1970 to 1979 and is widely recognized as being among the best in baseball history.
